product_updates.title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
product_updates.content: The proposed policy seems to offer protections against AI run amok but actually forbids federal agencies from blocking a model's release without the permission of a judge.

product_updates.title: Hugging Face CEO warns that Netflix’s OpenAI hack documentary isn’t accurate
product_updates.content: Before you share the Netflix documentary "AI Gone Rogue" take note. Clem Delangue, Hugging Face's co-founder who is featured in the film, says it went "full doomer mode" and isn't accurate.

product_updates.title: Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy
product_updates.content: Anthropic is reportedly struggling to secure enough compute from cloud providers that increasingly view it as a competitor, even as its infrastructure spending balloons ahead of a planned November IPO.

product_updates.title: SpaceX’s AI business is beating expectations
product_updates.content: SpaceX hit profitably in the third-quarter, with net income of $4.4 billion. AI was the engine.

product_updates.title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
product_updates.content: OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results.

product_updates.title: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia’s stronghold with AI app developers
product_updates.content: Google has joined Amazon in releasing a developer tool that makes it easy for PyTorch users to move their apps off Nvidia GPUs.

product_updates.title: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
product_updates.content: The company says the feature is designed for situations where users might be discussing something personal or planning a surprise and want to keep those conversations private when handing their device to friends or family to show them something in another chat.

product_updates.title: Eric Schmidt reportedly owns about half as much of Anthropic as CEO Dario Amodei
product_updates.content: The former Google CEO owns about 1% stake in the leading AI lab, Bloomberg reported.

product_updates.title: Meta’s Muse hits 10M U.S. downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
product_updates.content: Meta's AI companion Muse has surpassed 10 million U.S. downloads in its first 40 days, joining an exclusive group of apps that includes Threads. New data also shows Muse is retaining users at higher rates than its AI rivals.

product_updates.title: Plants can speak using electricity, so this startup built an AI model to decipher their language
product_updates.content: Electric Plant has built an AI-powered translator to help humans listen to what plants are saying with the subtle electricity coursing through their stems.
